title: S.H.I.E.L.D. #10 Marvel 2015 Howard the Duck Julian Totino Tedesco Cover Waid
conditionDescription: Clean, bright covers with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
S.H.I.E.L.D. #10 (Marvel, 2015 series), inspired by the Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. TV series. Howard the Duck cover by Julian Totino Tedesco, with Coulson and May. Credits on cover: Waid, Shaner, Wilson. Direct edition, $3.99 cover price.

Back cover: Playmation Avengers ad.

Condition: clean, bright covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
